title: How Many Truly Different Spells?
narrative: The grimoire has grown crowded — and the Cataloguer suspects some names point to the very same incantation. Count how many DIFFERENT incantations the book truly holds.
instructions:
The System provides `grimoire`, the dictionary. Do not assign it yourself.

Store in `distinct_count` how many DISTINCT incantations (values) the grimoire holds.

Two different names may point to the same incantation — count each incantation only once.

- `{"fire": "Ignis", "hearth": "Ignis", "water": "Aqua"}` has 2 distinct incantations.
